create_bigbird_attention_module: create a BigBirdAttention module with configurable heads, block size, and random blocks for sparse attention
create_bigbird_self_attention_module: create a BigBirdSelfAttention module for self-attention with sparse block random masking
run_sparse_dot_product_attention: run sparse dot product attention with queries, keys, values, and random block connectivity seed

create_rand_mask_from_inputs: create a 3D random attention mask from blocked masks and random attention indices
